name: intel_verify

findings.detail: kilo-free-model-intel.md lists 11 free models. kilo.json has 0 :free models wired. Actual provider config = 5 models total (2 OpenRouter, 3 Anthropic).
findings.impact: Auto free routing cannot hit catalogued free models unless they are added to provider config
findings.fix: Either wire :free models into kilo.json provider blocks, or route through Kilo Gateway which abstracts this. Current config routes to paid OpenRouter/Anthropic models only.
